messages:
leah: Ran the onboarding quickstart in a fresh org; right after credits applied the sample warmup spawned a big batch and we saw a waterfall of 429s. Minimal logs below.

peter: Hosted or Dedicated? paste logs.

leah: Hosted. log:
```
2024-07-12T12:11:45Z WARN req=onb1 status=429 Retry-After=1
2024-07-12T12:11:45Z DEBUG warmup spawn=28 inflight=38 window=128
```

niya: Oof. Looks like three things colliding: aggressive prefill, no jittered backoff, and auth refresh replaying warmup calls. We also have SDK parity problems: go quickstart uses prefill=20 while js/py differ. That makes some sampleapps more aggressive.

sam: Short-term fixes: change quickstart defaults to PREFILL=6, MAX_INFLIGHT=8; add env SAMPLEAPP_SAFE_WARMUP=true; implement jittered respect-Retry-After backoff. Medium-term: provide SDK helper "warmupLease" that hands out tokens so sampleapps can't burst more than N concurrent warmup requests.

leah: Love warmupLease idea. Sketch:
```js
// warmupLease pseudo
const lease = new WarmupLease({capacity:8, refillIntervalMs:1000});
await Promise.all(items.map(async it=>{
  await lease.acquire();
  try { await client.embed(it); } finally { lease.release(); }
}));
```

peter: Also propose SDK singleflight auth refresh to avoid duplicate token refresh work and attach X-Idempotency-Key on warmup requests so server can dedupe non-user payloads.

niya: For pagination, switch quickstart to streaming iterator (prefetch=1) and show a backpressure example that processes page N before fetching N+1. Many teams assume prefetch all, then spike.

sam: Created GH issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/1012 (labels: dx, onboarding, parity). I'll own JS impl and doc change. Can someone take py/go parity?

niya: I'll take Python. peter can you own Go?

peter: on it. I'll open PRs for sampleapp defaults + warmupLease helper. Also adding a tiny CI e2e that simulates credit grant and asserts inflight<=10 during warmup.

ci-bot: pipeline `quickstart/warmup-safety` queued on branch `devex/warmup-lease` — running smoke + concurrency assertion :white_check_mark:

leah: thanks. will re-run staging after PRs merge and post results. :rocket:
